//===== rAthena Script =======================================
//= Cash Shop
//===== Description: =========================================
//= nostalRE is played offline, where no cash points come in:
//= this NPC by Prontera's fountain sells kRO cash shop goods
//= for zeny instead, by category. The costume shops list
//= every costume in db/re/item_db_equip.yml (50,000 z each).
//============================================================

prontera,160,188,3	script	Cash Shop#prt	4_F_KAFRA1,{
	mes "[Cash Shop]";
	mes "Welcome! Everything the cash shop";
	mes "sells, for zeny. What are you after?";
	switch (select("Boosters & Scrolls:Food & Potions:Boxes & Refining:Capture Balls:Costumes:Nothing")) {
	case 1: callshop "CashShop_Boosters",1; break;
	case 2: callshop "CashShop_Food",1; break;
	case 3: callshop "CashShop_Boxes",1; break;
	case 4: callshop "CashShop_Capture",1; break;
	case 5:
		// every costume the item database has, by slot, a few hundred to a page
		clear;
		mes "[Cash Shop]";
		mes "Costumes, by where they are worn.";
		switch (select("Upper 1:Upper 2:Upper 3:Upper 4:Middle 1:Middle 2:Lower 1:Lower 2:Garment:Nothing")) {
		case 1: callshop "CashShop_Costume_Upper1",1; break;
		case 2: callshop "CashShop_Costume_Upper2",1; break;
		case 3: callshop "CashShop_Costume_Upper3",1; break;
		case 4: callshop "CashShop_Costume_Upper4",1; break;
		case 5: callshop "CashShop_Costume_Middle1",1; break;
		case 6: callshop "CashShop_Costume_Middle2",1; break;
		case 7: callshop "CashShop_Costume_Lower1",1; break;
		case 8: callshop "CashShop_Costume_Lower2",1; break;
		case 9: callshop "CashShop_Costume_Garment",1; break;
		}
		break;
	}
	end;

// a shop line holds only so many items (rAthena cuts it at 2047 characters): the costume shops get the
// rest here
